summary:
Prospective independently versioned FS.GG.Telemetry.Host 0.6.0 bundles the current Store14 implementation and accepts provider-usage-observation/1 through the existing authenticated generic receipt route. Envelope and receipt ABI remain unchanged. Passive facts retain authenticated owner checks, canonical-only attribution and corrections; qualified item totals do not include them. The fixed Store14 candidate, artifact verifier and eight-effect publisher bind telemetry-host/v0.6.0 and journal12. Candidate qualification requires eligible Linux x64, matching installed-package evidence and actual passive receipt correction/restore controls; a clean unsupported-storage refusal is not positive acceptance. Initial bounded local compilation and HTTP/schema controls passed at their original scope. Repaired tests use the existing exclusive collection for process-global Console and environment state; early CI includes the actual HTTP/schema and native output controls without dropping full-suite coverage. The original parallel Console failure is retained with cause unproved. The earlier source review and local qualification retain their original scopes. Full hosted and installed-package qualification subsequently passed before the authentic retained candidate; publication and service adoption remain separate. Published Host 0.5.0 and its original schema14 source/journal11, prior 0.4 profiles and every immutable artifact remain unchanged. This is independently versioned from the accepted coherent CLI/Kit/Drivers 0.106 publication; active installed 0.105 selection stays separate. Existing TLS and bearer API capability does not establish actual receiver endpoint, trust, enrollment, backup or readiness. Home owns stable receiver metadata; local producer capture remains useful without receiver credentials. Registry declarations, source review and local controls do not authorize publication or establish receiver adoption. The installed-browser control retains its exact one-applied/zero-rejected historical default; the current Store14 producer-correction callers explicitly require two applied and zero rejected receipts. The production fixture checks both exact applied SQLite rows before and after backup/restore. The earlier installed-browser count assertion failed under the current profile; passing other stages did not qualify that browser. Reviewed repaired source and bounded pure controls are not actual installed-package or service acceptance.

Authentic candidate39135954294/artifact12140420062 succeeded on protected543359. First publisher39137010941 failed with HTTP422 during legacy journal-ref creation. Its precise response and immutable-object identities were not retained; this does not prove zero effects. Independently observed retired-namespace policy forbids creation/update: successful read/absence preflight did not establish writer compatibility. All original custody remains retained.

Corrective source reuses the existing ProtectedReleaseJournal main-directory route for the same logical journal12. The existing ordinary protected-main writer/integrity/retired-fence predicate runs before genesis and each effect admission. Canonical-directory classification refuses malformed, unreadable, nested-missing or changed-main states rather than inferring fresh absence. Existing overlay/CAS preserves unrelated directories; no policy weakening or common release-pointer change is introduced.

Default fresh-source equality remains unchanged. An explicit default-false continuation admits only the genuine failed original attempt, fixed candidate/artifact/raw archive/content/package tuple and complete nontruncated source-tree ancestry. Only the finite reviewed publisher/control/plan and Atlas carrier paths may differ; existing immutable records and all other package inputs remain unchanged. This is neither a general descendant waiver nor a candidate rebuild, repack, reset or new logical journal.

Source controls cover the actual publisher with inert providers and a disposable real Git journal, unrelated-directory preservation, post-genesis policy drift, exact/default stale-source behavior, fixed-original/tuple/tree refusals and actual workflow flag handling. Their passing scope is source-only. The initial dirty-source generic-journal assertion remains retained before its separate clean-commit rerun. Final hosted checks, exact semantic review, admitted native continuation, feed/release verification and receiver installation are separate gates; neither candidate success nor this repair source establishes publication or installed service acceptance.
title: Host 0.6 publisher repair reuses protected main journal and retained candidate
